title: Movements Of All India Muslim League 1906
definition: The All India Muslim League (AIML) was a political organization established in 1906 to protect the political rights and interests of Muslims in British India, marking the formal institutionalization of communal politics.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Divide and Rule' policy, the evolution of communalism, the Lucknow Pact (1916), and the eventual trajectory toward the Two-Nation Theory.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Movements Of All India Muslim League 1906.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
